company.name: GoodShip
company.shortDescription: GoodShip is a freight orchestration platform offers shippers tools to manage and optimize their transportation networks efficiently.
company.description: GoodShip is a freight orchestration and procurement platform that streamlines how shippers manage transportation data, bids, and carrier relationships. It integrates tender, contract, performance, and market rate data into a unified dashboard that enables more informed decision-making and efficient RFP processes. The platform supports AI-powered bid recommendations, scenario modelling, carrier scorecards, and in-app messaging, making it easier to align stakeholders and manage corrective actions. GoodShip plugs seamlessly into existing TMS systems and is purpose-built to enhance collaboration between procurement and operations teams.
